datum: The merciful Lord hath instituted a memorial of his wondrous deeds.
He hath given Meat unto them that fear him.
V. The Word was made flesh. Alleluia.
R. And dwelt among us. Alleluia.
V. The Lord hath made known, alleluia.
V. All they from Saba shall come. Alleluia.
R. They shall bring gold and incense. Alleluia.
V. God is ascended with jubilee, alleluia.
R. And the Lord with the sound of trumpet, alleluia.
V. When Christ ascended up on high, alleluia.
R. He led captivity captive, alleluia.
V. They were all filled with the Holy Ghost, alleluia.
R. And began to speak, alleluia.
